description: Shared Markdown memory, bounded session context, source-attributed recall and verified backups for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Release v0.35.0 adds the shared webapp-principles skill and a canonical six-rule guide: responsibility-based JavaScript modules, layered CSS, screen/service boundaries, async loading, screen URLs and safe deployment updates in already-open tabs. Clean next navigation automatically loads changed app code; drafts and in-flight saves remain protected. Existing project instructions and frameworks take priority. The skill works outside a vault and does not authorize installation, deployment or application changes. Native discovery verification requires both enabled skills at their distinct expected installed paths and exact bundled resource bytes; discovery is not proof of application compliance. All v0.34.0 opt-in diagnostics and evaluations remain available. The seven certificate-bound checker files and harmless corpus are unchanged from v0.34.0, so this update alone does not require certificate regeneration. For older transitions where checker_sha256 changes: if warnings were promoted to fatal, revert them to warning, bring the Claude Code and Codex installations and a git vault's 00-meta/scripts engine copy to the same version (also when rolling back), regenerate the certificate there, then promote again. Regeneration includes the harmless replay. No default model or network call, hook change, runtime dependency or automatic vault migration is added.
